message: 1 payment event(s) do not match a known invoice.
impact: Unmatched cash cannot be safely assigned to revenue or receivables.
remediation: Route unmatched payments to suspense and investigate the source-system key.

message: 1 return event(s) do not match a known order line.
impact: Return allowances and inventory movement would be incomplete.
remediation: Reject or quarantine unmatched returns until line-level identity is restored.

message: A naive line-to-payment join overstates gross revenue by 11493.50 USD (11.97%).
impact: Many-to-many joins multiply line revenue when an invoice has multiple payments.
remediation: Aggregate lines, payments, and returns to their intended grain before joining at order_id.

message: The aggregate treatment effect has the opposite sign from every segment-level effect.
impact: A pooled rollout decision would confound treatment performance with a large change in traffic mix.
remediation: Use blocked randomization or a pre-specified post-stratified estimand and run a confirmatory experiment.

impact: Treatment and control do not represent the same mix of pre-treatment segments.
remediation: Balance assignment within segment and monitor allocation at ingestion time.

impact: Event-level failure rates and incident counts are inflated unless event_id is deduplicated.
remediation: Make event_id idempotent at the producer and deduplicate before metric aggregation.

message: Naive event failure-rate change is +5.303%; workflow-level final failure-rate change is +0.000%.
impact: Retries and duplicate instrumentation make the event denominator incomparable across periods.
remediation: Use unique workflow as the customer-outcome grain; report retry burden separately.

message: The largest failure-event concentration is partner / partner_timeout (16 events).
impact: A broad business-quality narrative would hide a concentrated source-system reliability issue.
